CustomField.description: Updates made to formula from SS-8550
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISBLANK(SBQQ__Partner__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(SBQQ__Account__r.Payment_Terms__c))) ), TEXT(SBQQ__Account__r.Payment_Terms__c), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(SBQQ__Partner__r.Payment_Terms__c))), TEXT(SBQQ__Partner__r.Payment_Terms__c), 'Net 30' ))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Payment Terms agreed upon in the Partner Agreement with Tanium (if indirect) or Customer's Master Agreement or EULA (if direct). This field will be blank for all Prospect Accounts quoted directly and some Partners
CustomField.label: Partner/Account Payment Terms
